'''Mister Grumbletail''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dewback/Legends|Dewback]] that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. At some point, it got sick of domesticated life and wandered into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], where it started attacking travellers. It was later killed by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="TOR" />
